remarks: **PRICE REDUCTION** Welcome to 75 Majestic Terrace, a well maintained and totally renovated in 2019; this two-family home is located on a dead-end street in the City of Lackawanna.  Both units have only been occupied by family members.  This spacious duplex offers a great opportunity for an owner occupant, extended family, or investor.  Each unit provides comfortable living space with its own kitchen, 3 bedrooms, and full bath, while the full basement offers excellent storage and utility space. Both units have been thoughtfully renovated with completely remodeled kitchens, baths, fresh paint throughout, new windows, siding, central air, lighting fixtures, fans, and doors.  There are two separate entrances to the property which gives   privacy to the owner or tenants.  The roof was replaced in 2019, adding peace of mind to the next owner.  Each unit also features separate utilities, providing convenience and flexibility.  The third bedroom in each unit can also be used as a laundry room as the hook ups have already been installed. The property offers ample parking for 2 plus vehicles along with a spacious 2.5 car garage with electric and a convenient patio door going out to the concrete patio in the back yard.   The shed in the back yard offers plenty of storage for summer furniture, tools, and toys.  Conveniently located near Abbott Rd, shopping, dining, schools, and major roadways, with easy access to Buffalo and the surrounding south towns. Offers will be reviewed if any on Monday, October 19th at 12PM. Seller cannot accept any contingent offers.
